description: Reads or records the one-time next-step ask for one Cloud site, Data project, Studio app, Mobile starter, or the Code workspace. Actions are read, ask, decline, accept, continue, reopen, and enable. read returns whether the ask is still pending. ask records it once and returns the real next steps (mobile-starter, data-project, studio-app, cloud-site, cloud-deploy, or mcp-plugin). decline turns one path, or every path, off. accept records a choice and creates nothing. continue creates only the step you name, or returns instructions when that path creates nothing. reopen shows the ask again and creates nothing. enable turns one declined path back on. Use guidance for that ask. Use create_project to create without the ask, status to see guidancePending, and eas_dispatch for Expo. continue does not deploy, start an EAS build, or charge. If status reports guidancePending true, call this once with action ask. Do not repeat the ask after guidance says it was already asked.

action.description: read, ask, decline, accept, continue, reopen, or enable. Omitted means ask. ask writes the ask once. continue creates only when the chosen path creates a project.

name.description: Name used when continue creates a project. Required with slug for a Cloud site. Other products have a default derived from the source name.

path.description: Step id for decline, accept, continue, and enable. Not every id is offered on every product. decline without path turns every path for that product off.

product.description: Product that owns the ask: cloud, data, mobile, studio, or code.

projectId.description: UUID of the Cloud, Data, Studio, or Mobile project. Omit for the Code workspace.

slug.description: Public address used when continue creates a Cloud site. Required together with name. Same rules as create_project slug.

name: guidance
title: Record the one-time next-step ask
